title: Caribou Biosciences Says CRISPR CAR-T Is Pivotal-Ready, CB-011 Data Nears
summary: Caribou Biosciences (NASDAQ:CRBU) Chief Executive Officer Rachel Haurwitz said the company is advancing two CRISPR-enabled, off-the-shelf CAR T cell therapy programs, with its lymphoma candidate vispa-cel now “pivotal-ready” and its multiple myeloma program CB-011 continuing in Phase 1 development.
